Name: slO's Grand Farmhouse
Author: slpOff
Description:
[center][size=6][b]slO's Grand Farmhouse[/b][/size]

[size=4]A spacious home for your life in the valley.[/size][/center]

Give your farmer a little more room to settle in. [b]slO's Grand Farmhouse[/b] replaces the farmhouse interiors with a grander layout, offering plenty of space to decorate and make your own.

As your farmhouse grows, you can customize it further through Robin's renovation menu. Add an upper area for even more space, or create your own indoor pool for a relaxing break from farm work.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Replaces the farmhouse interiors, including upgraded and marriage versions.[/*]
[*]Adds an optional upper area through Robin's renovation menu.[/*]
[*]Adds an optional indoor pool through Robin's renovation menu.[/*]
[*]Includes space for decorating and arranging furniture.[/*]
[*]Adds a garden area beside the pool.[/*]
[*]Includes cellar access and an additional exit to the farm in the upgraded farmhouse.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/*]
[*]Make New Farmhouse[/*]
[/list]
Install the requirements, then place this content pack in the appropriate [b]Make New Farmhouse[/b] farmhouses folder.
